description: Structural context of UNC119 Gly22: AlphaFold confidence and experimental structure coverage
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# AlphaFold model of UNC119A (Q13432): is Gly22 in a structured, functionally relevant region?
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q13432", timeout=90).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(af["pdbUrl"], timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for ln in pdb.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        rows.append({"resi":int(ln[22:26]), "resn":ln[17:20].strip(), "plddt":float(ln[60:66]),
                     "x":float(ln[30:38]),"y":float(ln[38:46]),"z":float(ln[46:54])})
d=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("AlphaFold model:", af["entryId"], "residues:", len(d))
print("Residue 22:", d.loc[d.resi==22, ["resn","plddt"]].to_dict("records"))
print("Mean pLDDT whole chain: %.1f" % d.plddt.mean())
print("Mean pLDDT N-term 1-50: %.1f" % d[d.resi<=50].plddt.mean())
print("Mean pLDDT beta-sandwich core 60-240: %.1f" % d[d.resi>=60].plddt.mean())
print("Fraction of residues 1-50 with pLDDT < 50 (very low): %.2f" % (d[d.resi<=50].plddt.lt(50).mean()))
print("Fraction of residues 60-240 with pLDDT > 90 (very high): %.2f" % (d[d.resi>=60].plddt.gt(90).mean()))

# Experimental structures covering UNC119A
pdbe = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pdbe/api/mappings/best_structures/Q13432", timeout=90).json()
ents = pdbe.get("Q13432", [])
print("\nPDB entries mapped to Q13432:", len({e['pdb_id'] for e in ents}))
cov=[]
for e in ents:
    cov.append((e["pdb_id"], e["chain_id"], e["unp_start"], e["unp_end"], e.get("resolution")))
cv=pd.DataFrame(cov, columns=["pdb","chain","unp_start","unp_end","res"]).drop_duplicates("pdb")
print(cv.head(20).to_string(index=False))
print("\nMinimum UniProt start residue observed in any experimental structure:", cv.unp_start.min())
print("Number of structures whose modelled region includes residue 22:", ((cv.unp_start<=22)&(cv.unp_end>=22)).sum())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
ax.plot(d.resi, d.plddt, lw=1.4, color="#4C72B0")
ax.axhspan(0,50, color="#C44E52", alpha=0.08); ax.axhspan(90,100, color="#55A868", alpha=0.08)
ax.axvline(22, color="#C44E52", lw=1.6, ls="--")
ax.annotate("Gly22\n(reported ICL variant)\npLDDT %.0f" % d.loc[d.resi==22,"plddt"].values[0],
            xy=(22, d.loc[d.resi==22,"plddt"].values[0]), xytext=(45, 30),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#C44E52"), color="#C44E52", fontsize=9)
ax.axvspan(cv.unp_start.min(), cv.unp_end.max(), color="grey", alpha=0.12)
ax.text((cv.unp_start.min()+cv.unp_end.max())/2, 97,
        f"region resolved in experimental crystal structures ({cv.unp_start.min()}-{cv.unp_end.max()})",
        ha="center", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("UNC119A residue (UniProt Q13432)"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT")
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,240)
ax.set_title("Gly22 lies in the disordered N-terminal arm of UNC119A, outside every solved structure")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
